import re
from datetime import datetime


def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line (combined log format) into a dictionary.

    Expected format:
    IP - - [timestamp] "METHOD /path HTTP/1.1" status bytes "referer" "user-agent"

    Returns:
        dict with keys: ip, timestamp, method, path, protocol, status, bytes, referer, user_agent
    """
    # Regex for combined log format
    pattern = r'^(\S+) (\S+) (\S+) \[([^\]]+)\] "(\S+) (\S+) (\S+)" (\d{3}) (\S+) "([^"]*)" "([^"]*)"'
    match = re.match(pattern, line.strip())
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse log line: {line}")

    try:
